verdict.rationale: Box documents a broad REST API that mirrors most core UI functions: chunked uploads, shared links, collaborations and permissions, full-text search, metadata templates, events, webhooks, Box AI, and Box Sign (explicitly described as the 'full Box Sign web app experience' through the API). However, no evidence claims or verifies general UI-to-API parity, and coverage of many UI areas is simply not shown. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of UI/API parity, evidence for admin, settings, and other UI surfaces such as Notes, Hubs management, and annotations via API, and independent hands-on confirmation that nothing is UI-only.
